name: Blackberry
siboNotes: Low FODMAP berry that's well-tolerated in SIBO diets. High fiber content may cause digestive discomfort in sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Rinse gently just before eating to preserve freshness
Remove any stems or leaves before consuming
Can be eaten fresh, frozen, or cooked without affecting FODMAP content
Store in refrigerator and use within 2-3 days for best quality
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin C and antioxidants
Low in calories and natural sugars
